title: Hearty Slovakian Flour Dumplings
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with yeast and all purpose flour, these dumplings are paleo-friendly and perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add the water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Place the dumplings in the steamer basket, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Cover the steamer and cook for 15 minutes.
Remove the dumplings from the steamer and serve hot with melted butter.
Serve the dumplings as a solo dinner and enjoy.
